priority_items.title: Panguna landowner ceremony (16 Sep) now wired; Ona-family chief says he backs redevelopment
priority_items.summary: In-window NBC (17 Sep 09:20 PGT / 23:20 UTC): Panguna Landowner Interim Council, chiefs and representatives from Guava, Dapera, Moroni and Pirurari held a Wednesday 16 Sep ceremony apologising to ABG and LPMEL for the 13 Sep arson. Guava Chief Titus Miri (brother of the late Francis Ona) is quoted stepping down and giving full support to redevelopment. Witnessed by Veterans Minister Dake, Ioro MP Miringtoro, BPS Deputy Commissioner Tokura. Named-community colour, not a BPS SITREP, not unanimous closure (Pipiro mixed leftover still on file). ABG site still silent. NBC homepage now leads this item (was Enga leftover). Not FLASH.

priority_items.title: Labour promises PIF visa-free NZeTA; opposition policy, not a gazette
priority_items.summary: Near-cutoff RNZ Pacific (17 Sep 11:49 NZST / 23:49 UTC): NZ Labour Deputy Leader Carmel Sepuloni promises visa-free NZeTA access for Pacific Islands Forum countries, three months at a time, if the government changes. Complements INZ Thursday figures: overall overstayers down 8.7% to 19,153 but Pacific share ~26% (from 25%); 2,541 Tongan and 1,462 Samoan overstayers estimated. NZ First clemency leftover; Greens support; National not drawn. Not MFAT policy, not an NZeTA gazette, not a compact. Now RNZ RSS lead. Not FLASH.
